verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents that its issued cards are Visa multi-currency cards usable in 140+ currencies with no international transaction fees, and markets them with 'No FX Fees'. That covers the spend-abroad half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows ATM or cash withdrawal on the cards, or the fees for it, so the withdraw-cash half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented ATM/cash withdrawal abroad and its fee terms, a full fee schedule ruling out other hidden charges, and independent or hands-on corroboration of no foreign fees.
